title: Keto Moroccan Brie Bites
description: A rich and creamy keto appetizer or snack, inspired by the flavors of Morocco. Perfect for a quick indulgence.

ingredients.name: Brie Cheese, softened
ingredients.notes: Make sure to choose a high-quality, strong blue cheese

ingredients.name: Moroccan Amlou
ingredients.notes: A traditional Moroccan nut paste made from almonds, honey, and argan oil

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the softened brie cheese, understated cream cheese, and granulated sweetener. Mix until smooth.
Add the Moroccan amlou and mix until well combined.
Stir in the chopped fresh thyme.
Gradually add the almond flour to the cheese mixture and mix until a dough forms.
Cover the dough with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Using a small cookie scoop or spoon, form the dough into small balls, about 1 inch in diameter.
Place the brie bites on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until the edges are lightly golden brown.
